prompt: Create a studio portrait on a vertical 4:5 canvas with a plain dark gray seamless background and soft, realistic photography lighting. Show one real young adult Asian man standing slightly left of center, full body visible, wearing an oversized black hoodie, a white undershirt peeking out, loose light-wash denim shorts, white crew socks, and white-and-red sneakers. He has short textured black hair with straight fringe and black rectangular glasses, a mildly confused, skeptical expression, and he looks to his right toward the empty space. His posture is relaxed with arms down, feet planted, and shoulders slightly turned. Above his head, add exactly 2 black hand-drawn question marks, one larger and one smaller, as doodle accents. To the right of him, create his mischievous doodle shadow as if drawn in rough black charcoal or marker directly on the background: a cartoon version of the same man, larger and more energetic, grinning widely with oversized glasses, wearing a hoodie, shorts, socks, and sneakers. The doodle shadow is in a playful dancing pose with one knee raised, one foot on the ground, both arms up making peace signs; include exactly 2 visible peace-sign hands. Add expressive sketch marks around the doodle: exactly 3 small exclamation strokes above the doodle head, exactly 1 tiny question mark near the left raised hand, exactly 5 curved motion marks around the arms, leg, and body, and a scribbled dark ground shadow under the doodle foot. Style the doodle with loose, messy, crosshatched black lines, semi-transparent enough to read as a drawn shadow but bold enough to stand out. Keep the real person photorealistic and the doodle shadow 2D hand-sketched, with no other objects, no watermark, and no extra text.

promptZh: 在 4:5 的竖向画布上创作一张摄影棚肖像，背景为纯深灰色无缝背景，采用柔和的写实摄影布光。画面中展示一位真实的亚洲年轻男性，位于画面中心偏左，全身可见，身穿 一件超大号黑色连帽衫，露出白色内搭，宽松的浅色水洗牛仔短裤，白色中筒袜，以及红白配色运动鞋。他留着 黑色短碎发，带有直刘海，佩戴黑色长方形眼镜，表情略显困惑和怀疑，正看向他右侧的空白处。他姿态放松，双臂下垂，双脚站稳，肩膀微微转向。在他的头顶上方，添加 2 个黑色手绘问号作为涂鸦装饰，一个较大，一个较小。在他右侧，创作出他那顽皮的涂鸦影子，仿佛是用粗黑炭笔或马克笔直接画在背景上：一个与该男子形象一致的卡通版本，体型更大且更具活力，咧嘴大笑，戴着超大号眼镜，穿着连帽衫、短裤、袜子和运动鞋。涂鸦影子呈现出俏皮的跳舞姿势，单膝抬起，一只脚着地，双臂向上比出剪刀手；确保画面中包含 2 只清晰可见的剪刀手。在涂鸦周围添加富有表现力的素描笔触：涂鸦头部上方添加 3 个小感叹号，左侧抬起的手附近添加 1 个小问号，手臂、腿部和身体周围添加 5 个弧形运动轨迹线，并在涂鸦脚下添加涂鸦风格的深色地面阴影。涂鸦风格应采用随意、杂乱的交叉排线，半透明度适中，既能看出是绘制的影子，又足够醒目。保持真人部分为写实摄影风格，涂鸦影子为 2D 手绘风格，画面中不包含其他物体，无水印，无额外文字。
